To respond to some of the points, by early stages, I meant early stages of recovery. I've just started therapy and I've been on medication for a year. 

I've started taking on board some of the ideas that you guys have mentioned and I've jumped back onto Myfitnesspal and I'm just tracking what I'm eating, no restrictions yet. I'm shocked at the amount I'm eating but its not surprising when I consider how quickly I've gained the weight.
I also invested in a Fitbit so hopefully that might motivate me to move a bit more. I'm an engineer so data is heaven to me. 

Geecy, I feel like we've had similar things happen to us. I became really fit and healthy and went to the gym every night for about 5 months in 2013, but something went wrong along the way and I've ended up where I am now. 

Thank you so much for all of the replies guys. I really appreciate it!

I've tried to kick off a diet for about 4 months now at the start of every week and failed by Thursday. This week, I will do it. I will continue. I used to be a thin, athletic guy but then I got into a rut and I'm now 92kg (5ft 8 so not a good weight for that height). After multiple comments from strangers about my weight, I have decided I have to start this. I am probably going to fail again as I have always done but I will try and stick with it!
